notes.title: The Sidekick Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]The "Sidekick Update" is LIVE!!![/h2]

We've been working hard to implement TONS of player feedback, and as some of you may have noticed over the weekend… we've sneakily released:

[h3]A NEW FLOWER SIDEKICK![/h3] - Speak to the Kindness Keeper's helper in the Community Hub to get an Ecosystem Quest! It’ll even join you around the map — whispering the world's needs to you!

[h3]TONS OF UI UPGRADES[/h3] - We've revamped a ton of the game's menus! Things should be as approachable and clear as ever!

[h3]Cleaner Hub[/h3] - We’ve done some house cleaning for the Community Hub to make sure it isn’t too overwhelming!

[h3]NEW PUBLIC SERVER[/h3] - We've created a fresh new world for everyone! You can still join the previous server by adding the “jimjum_apple” server in your Server list.

[h3]EXISTING PLAYERS:[/h3]

If you get any connectivity errors: please try reinstalling the game or clearing your game’s cache. If that doesn’t work — reach out to us on Discord and we’ll figure it out together!

Also:

Game dev is incredibly hard so it’s inevitable things get delayed, but we’ll be making some big announcements soon. You should be noticing a lot more activity soon too! ;)

[b]LET US KNOW WHAT YOU THINK AND DON’T FORGET WE LOVE YOU ALL!!!![/b]

notes.title: The "Warm Welcome" Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]New Update and a 🔥New Official Powershot🔥[/h2]

As we gear up toward a big release, we've been focusing on a completely new tutorial and adding some love and polish to the existing game mechanics!

[h2]✨🤗 "Warm Welcome" Update 🤗✨[/h2]

[h3]🌸 New Tutorial[/h3]
New players are now warmly welcomed into the world by the Kindness Keeper, who teaches them everything they need to know about our blank world!

[h3]📖 Ecosystem Recipe Book (200+)[/h3]
Check out all the Ecosystem Recipes you've unlocked, now viewable through the inventory!

[h3]🍃 World Leaf Polish[/h3]
We've added some loving polish to the World Leaf! It should now be easier to use and understand.

[h3]🎶 Fresh Music and SFX[/h3]
Enjoy some delicious new treats for your ears with updated music and sound effects!

[h3]🪲 Bug Fixes[/h3]
The game should now be much more stable!

[h3]🌈 Update Now![/h3]

Don't forget to update!

We've got another update coming very soon — and after that, some very big news! 😶

Let us know what you think of the new Powershot in [b]our [url=https://discord.gg/ApMawEUjjP]Discord![/url][/b]

notes.title: THE WORLD LEAF UPDATE IS LIVE!!!
notes.notes:
[h2]This is an OUTRAGEOUSLY HUGE UPDATE everyone![/h2]

After an unbelievable amount of work, we're proud to welcome you all to the:

[h1]The WORLD LEAF UPDATE[/h1]

[h3]Discover Ecosystems![/h3]
Use the World Leaf to mark around areas you've built! Each ecosystem is a result of its own special tile combo! We'd LOVE to hear your feedback and suggestions.

Share your ideas for Ecosystem Combos in our [url=https://discord.gg/J9R5v8T6Dm]Discord[/url] for a chance to have them added into the game!

[h3]NEW QUESTS[/h3]  
The Kindness Keeper will now hand out scrolls with Ecosystem Quests on them! Can you figure them all out?

[h3]XP Balancing[/h3]  
Level progression should be much smoother now!

[h3]New Tutorial[/h3]  
We've added a mini tutorial for new players that does a better job of introducing the game!

[h3]New Music and SFX[/h3]  
New ecosystems for your EARS!

We can't wait to hear what you all think on our community!  

Update your game to the latest version and [b]GO RESTORE NATURE TO THE WORLD![/b]

notes.title: The WORLDS AND WORLDS Update!
notes.notes:
[b]HUGE Update everyone!!! Communite is now more social than ever![/b]

We humbly present to you... the:

[h2]WORLDS AND WORLDS UPDATE![/h2]

Buckle up:

[h3]CREATE YOUR OWN SERVER!!![/h3]

WHAT?! Finally, you can create a world for YOUR community!

Open your own community with your friends, or hop between worlds to help different communities on their journey.

Currently, auto-verification requires a Twitch account, but we'll be expanding integrations soon!

[h3]2 NEW FRIENDS are waiting to meet you[/h3]

The mushroom kingdom needs your help, and so does a particularly hotheaded mountain (names chosen by our wonderful [url=https://discord.com/invite/Gh7PK8u2b7]Discord[/url] community)!

[h3]Trending Servers[/h3]

Public servers can now be featured in the main menu!

Streaming servers will appear as LIVE, and extremely active servers will appear as HOT!
Grow your community, meet new friends, and build together!

[h3]Revamped Main Menu[/h3]

Create, join, and navigate between servers easier than ever! 

----

That's all for now! Meanwhile, we've been working on a mysterious new feature, the World Brush (secret test in our Discord!)

EXPECT SOME BIG DEVELOPMENTS SOON!

notes.title: The "Update Between Updates" Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s been a while! We’ve had a blast hearing all your feedback about our new quest system. We’ve learned a lot, and there’s even more on the way.

Expect more news soon, but while it’s cooking, we’d like to welcome you all to the:

[h2][b]“Update Between Updates” Update![/b][/h2]

On today’s menu:

[b]A NEW FRIEND HAS ARRIVED![/b]
Bert, the Solar Scientist, is waiting to meet you in the Community Hub!

[b]New Level-Up Notifications[/b]
To avoid clutter, once you level up, a little present will follow you around. It’s up to you when to open it and enjoy your new tiles in a colorful explosion!

[b]Daily Spark Rewards[/b]
Get some sparks and a kind word from us every day! We’re working on balancing, and this is the first step - check the shop!

[b]HUGE Server Upgrades[/b]
We've been working tirelessly to ensure more players can play together than ever before!

Special thanks to the Felps community for playing so much that the game exploded!
We know some of you are here. 💚 You really helped us identify the weak spots so we could fix them! 🏆

That’s it for now! Keep your eyes peeled - and if you haven't already, [b]JOIN OUR DISCORD![/b] We’ll need your help naming some NPCs (and completely new features) very soon!!!

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE!!! NPC QUESTS ARE LIVE!!!
notes.notes:
You've been patient, we’ve been crunching, and it's finally here

[b]Welcome to the one and only OUTRAGEOUSLY BIG UPDATE![/b] Buckle up, because we now have:

[h2]FRIENDSHIP QUESTS!!![/h2]

[b]Communite now has real Quests! [/b]Befriend new characters and grow your friendship to earn new tiles, skins, and emblems!

This is just the beginning. We’ve built the infrastructure to add a TON of new characters and surprise content down the road! [b]Start by speaking to your new BFF in the community hub - The Scouting Squirrel.[/b]

[h2]Special Biomes![/h2]

Castles?! SPACE?! [b]Check your inventory to find out![/b]

[h2]New World Background![/h2]

The Great Blank has changed from a canvas of pure white to [b]an endless dryland for you to heal[/b]

[h2]New Customizations![/h2]

New equipment and [b]a little present especially for all of you in the community![/b] Check the Style shop!

[h2]New Music and SFX![/h2]

New friends means[b] new music and fresh treats for your ears![/b]

[h2]Tons of Bug Fixes![/h2]

- So… so many bug fixes.

[b]We’re only going to expand from here. Expect new characters and quests very soon, and an announcement on our next big feature even sooner! [/b]
